Water Leakage.title: Inspect leakage
Water Leakage.description: Assess the source and severity of the water leakage.

Water Leakage.title: Isolate/repair pipeline
Water Leakage.description: Shut off water supply if necessary and repair the damaged pipeline.

Water Leakage.title: Verify restoration
Water Leakage.description: Restore water supply and verify no further leakage.

Road Damage.title: Inspect road damage
Road Damage.description: Assess the extent of the potholes or road damage.

Road Damage.title: Repair road surface
Road Damage.description: Fill potholes and resurface the affected road area.

Road Flooding.title: Inspect flooded road
Road Flooding.description: Assess the flooded area and identify the cause of water accumulation.

Road Flooding.title: Clear obstruction
Road Flooding.description: Clear any drainage blockages contributing to the flooding.

Road Flooding.title: Restore affected road
Road Flooding.description: Ensure the road is safe and functional post-flooding.

Drainage Overflow.title: Inspect drainage system
Drainage Overflow.description: Identify the point of overflow or blockage.

Drainage Overflow.title: Clear drainage blockage
Drainage Overflow.description: Remove debris or silt causing the overflow.

Drainage Overflow.title: Sanitize area
Drainage Overflow.description: Clean and sanitize the surrounding area affected by sewage.

Garbage Accumulation.title: Assess garbage dump
Garbage Accumulation.description: Evaluate the volume and type of accumulated waste.

Garbage Accumulation.title: Clear garbage
Garbage Accumulation.description: Dispatch vehicles to collect and clear the accumulated garbage.

Garbage Accumulation.title: Clean area
Garbage Accumulation.description: Clean the area to prevent health hazards and stray animal gathering.

Streetlight Failure.title: Inspect streetlight
Streetlight Failure.description: Identify if the issue is a fused bulb, wiring, or timer.

Streetlight Failure.title: Repair or replace streetlight
Streetlight Failure.description: Fix the wiring or replace the faulty streetlight.

Electrical Hazard.title: Inspect electrical hazard
Electrical Hazard.description: Identify exposed wires, sparking, or broken infrastructure.

Electrical Hazard.title: Secure exposed electrical equipment
Electrical Hazard.description: Isolate the area to prevent public access and electrocution.

Electrical Hazard.title: Repair electrical hazard
Electrical Hazard.description: Fix the underlying electrical issue safely.

Electrical Hazard.title: Verify safety
Electrical Hazard.description: Test the equipment to ensure it is completely safe.

Power Outage.title: Investigate power outage
Power Outage.description: Identify the transformer or grid failure causing the outage.

Power Outage.title: Restore power grid
Power Outage.description: Repair the fault and restore electricity supply.

Public Safety Hazard.title: Resolve safety hazard
Public Safety Hazard.description: Remove or fix the object/structure causing the hazard.
